note: Milliseconds, median of 5 runs in Vitest browser mode (Chromium), measured by src/test/performance.test.ts. Each budget is about 3x the median of three suite runs on the shared development host (25 ms floor), never above the previous budget, so a 2x slowdown fails while CI retry absorbs noise. mount = first render + layout; update = the change named in the scenario + layout. A scenario's name says what it renders: lazy-50 and collapsed mean the component draws only that part of the data.
